items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: Romy Britell is identified in the notes as 'the Archive’s transcriptionist' who 'participated briefly in the interview.' The interviewee mentions her name in passing ('after Romy leaves') and thanks her ('Thank you, Monk and Romy'), indicating a professional/acquaintance relationship within the cont

ctx.x: Who took you to the gigs when you were 15?

My parents sometimes, sometimes the people that would hire me. Jack Palmer, the first gig I can remember the trip with him, he came and picked me up and I wish I could tell you that story but unfortunately I can’t. But after Romy leaves and we’re alone, I’ll tell you the first thing he ever said to me in the car on the way to a gig, which is very funny but —
Okay, that’s for part two which will be inaccessible.
